requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3220-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-2500-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

789-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-7374-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-7374-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
The Lost and the Damned triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-5359-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2104-6568-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

224-2157-6664-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to The Wandering Minstrel
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

57-2341-3480-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-2341-3480-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-1879-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3499-3519-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3499-3519-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate a Forest Dryad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 3 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

955-2615-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
955-2615-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

1460-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
1460-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
1460-4067-5672.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1462-2034-2812.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-2034-2812.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Knight of Doves triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

1987-2128-4125.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1987-2128-4125.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

229-1661-5220.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

313-2792-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
313-2792-4050.description:
Activate up to fiva mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
Repeat.
